changelog:
Initial release of zhiyierxing-auto-phone skill for end-to-end phone agent deployment and operation.

- Enables product-grade, runnable phone-agent workflows for Zhipu AutoGLM-Phone / Open-AutoGLM on Android, HarmonyOS, and iPhone.
- Accepts natural-language phone task requests and automatically infers/setup environment, device connection, dependencies, and model endpoints as needed.
- Aggressively reuses any existing environments, dependencies, and device connections; prompts user only when an actual runtime blocker is detected.
- Provides clear, step-by-step troubleshooting and precise user instructions when manual intervention is required.
- Supports cross-platform deployment (macOS, Linux, Windows) and covers all host/device prerequisites, model validation, and smoke-test verification before executing the target phone task.
